# Nile Js

TypeScript-first, service and actions oriented backend framework.

Full text: https://nile-js.github.io/nile/llms-full.txt

## Guides

- [Composing hooks](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/advanced/composing-hooks): Build a checkout from local before and after hooks, a global after hook and clear rules for critical steps
- [Execution options](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/advanced/execution-options): Set a timeout for each execution and layer rate limits from the server down to one action
- [Handler context](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/advanced/handler-context): Use the second argument of an action handler to read resources, the session, execution details and topic publishing
- [Advanced](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/advanced): Go beyond a single action: use handler context, compose hooks, set execution limits and test actions
- [Testing actions](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/advanced/testing-actions): Test action rules with server.invoke and Bun's test runner, without starting an HTTP listener
- [Build with AI agents](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/agents): Work with a coding assistant on Nile Js services: why the structure suits agents, which documentation to give them, and a workflow that keeps changes safe
- [Nile Js skill](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/agents/skill): Install the SKILL.md file that ships with @nilejs/nile so a coding assistant follows Nile Js conventions
- [Actions](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/actions): Define an operation with input validation, access rules and a Result
- [Authentication and access](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/auth): Verify credentials and apply access policies before business work runs
- [Frontend client](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/client): Call service actions from a browser or server TypeScript app and check each Result before reading its value
- [Shared context](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/context): Share application resources while keeping request identity and action state isolated
- [Custom routes](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/custom-routes): Add HTTP routes for webhooks, downloads and streaming responses
- [Discovery and agents](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/discovery-and-agents): Expose selected action schemas for tools and coding agents
- [Errors and Results](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/errors-and-results): Return expected failures and guard operations with Slang Results
- [Public assets](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/file-serving): Serve application assets through the selected HTTP adapter
- [Hooks and pipelines](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/hooks-and-pipelines): Compose shared policies and action-specific work in a defined execution order
- [HTTP interaction](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/interacting): Send an action request and handle its HTTP response
- [Services](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/services): Group related actions into an explicitly registered business domain
- [Input contracts](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/type-system): Keep action inputs, validation schemas and frontend contracts aligned
- [File uploads](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/basics/uploads): Receive and validate multipart files through an action
- [File upload](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/examples/file-upload): Accept a document through a multipart action with count, size and type limits, then send it from a client and from curl
- [Examples](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/examples): Build complete Nile Js features step by step, with every file, the exact commands and the output you should see
- [Protected profile](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/examples/protected-profile): Add JWT verification to the starter, read the signed-in user in an action, and enforce a role with a global before hook
- [Rate-limited quote](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/examples/rate-limited-quote): Publish a public price action that allows a short burst per client, then refuses requests until the bucket refills
- [Realtime order updates](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/examples/realtime-orders): Define typed order topics, verify the JWT on each socket connection, publish from a protected action and receive updates in a client
- [Tasks API in React](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/examples/tasks-react): Call the starter's tasks actions from a React component with @nilejs/client, handle failures and allow the Vite origin
- [Weekly report](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/examples/weekly-report): Build a weekly report from the tasks table with a cron job, hand delivery to a queue and run the job on demand
- [API discovery and schemas](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/api-discovery): Let trusted tools list services and read action input schemas through the explore and schema intents
- [Authentication and hooks](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/authentication-and-hooks): Protect actions with JWT verification, enforce required roles and run checks before or after an action
- [HTTP, WebSocket and direct calls](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/calling-actions): Call one action from HTTP, a socket client or your own backend code, and know what each path requires
- [Context and logging](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/context-and-logging): Read shared resources, the current session and execution details from a handler, and write structured logs
- [Cron jobs](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/cron-jobs): Run recurring business work on calendar, interval or one-time schedules, and trigger a job by hand for testing
- [Database models](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/database-models): Create typed model helpers from a Drizzle table for inserts, lookups, updates, deletes and pagination
- [File uploads](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/file-uploads): Accept multipart files in an action with count, size, filename and type limits, and read them as a structured payload
- [Features](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features): Find the Nile Js feature you need, with a short description and a link to its guide page
- [Queues, debounce and throttle](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/queues-debounce-throttle): Limit concurrency with queues, collapse repeated calls with debounce and cap call frequency with throttle
- [Rate limiting](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/rate-limiting): Limit how often a client can call an action, using a shared limiter with per-service and per-action policies
- [Readiness and shutdown](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/readiness-and-shutdown): Expose readiness and liveness endpoints, then stop accepting work and drain in-flight executions on shutdown
- [Retries and utilities](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/retries-and-utilities): Retry external calls with jittered backoff, keep a bounded short-lived store, and wrap database failures safely
- [Telemetry](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/telemetry): Send action traces and metrics from Nile Js to an OpenTelemetry collector over OTLP HTTP
- [Validation and errors](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/validation-and-errors): Validate action input with Zod and return expected failures as Results that clients can read
- [WebSockets](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/features/websockets): Define typed topics, control who can subscribe or publish, send messages from actions and receive them in a client
- [Build with Nile](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide): Ship business operations with a consistent structure your team can follow as the application grows
- [CORS](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/internals/cors): Choose allowed origins globally and for individual action routes
- [Model helpers](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/internals/db/create-model): Create a Drizzle-backed model with typed CRUD methods and Result failures
- [Data access](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/internals/db): Keep data access in application models and use the optional Drizzle helpers
- [Engine](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/internals/engine): Understand action lookup, pipeline order and registration statistics
- [Logging](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/internals/logging): Follow related executions through structured logs and correlation IDs
- [REST](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/internals/rest): Configure the HTTP action endpoint, discovery and adapter behavior
- [Server](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/internals/server): Configure resources, interfaces, startup and registration statistics
- [FAQ](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/reference/faq): Answers to common questions about Nile applications and their tradeoffs
- [Choosing Nile](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/reference/framework-comparison): Choose an application model around the work your team needs to ship
- [Full documentation bundle](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/reference/llms-full-txt): Download the complete Nile guide collection as plain text
- [Coding assistants](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/reference/llms-txt): Give coding assistants the same service and action documentation your team reads
- [Running Nile in production](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/reference/operations): Run direct calls, schedules, controlled work and diagnostics in production
- [Performance and methodology](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/reference/performance): Read the recorded shopping-workflow results and reproduce the comparison
- [Sockets and typed messages](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/reference/realtime): Invoke actions and exchange validated topic messages through Socket.IO
- [Shared backend utilities](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/reference/shared-utilities): Use database, retry, storage and execution helpers through the utils namespace
- [Application structure](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/start/application-structure): Give each service, action and business rule a predictable place as your team grows
- [Deployment](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/start/deploy): Build, check readiness and shut down a Nile application
- [From REST to Nile](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/start/from-rest): Map familiar HTTP operations to services and named actions
- [Getting started](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/start/getting-started): Create a Nile Js project, call its first action, add an action that changes data and call it from a client
- [Migration guide](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/start/migration): Introduce services and actions alongside an existing application
- [Runtime adapters](https://nile-js.github.io/nile/guide/start/runtime-adapters): Choose Bun native or the Hono adapter and connect your HTTP listener
